correctness.rationale: For unit vectors the probability-one condition forces a unitary eigenmoment identity. Exact first moments uniquely imply gamma=1-pi; exact second moments imply (1/d_w)sum_neighbors(1/d_v)=d_w/(2m-d_w). Cauchy–Schwarz and positivity of degrees yield equality iff w universal and neighbor degrees identical. A cone over k-regular base has a rigorously invariant orthonormal two-state subspace, whose reduced H squares to I/(k+2); analytic exponentiation gives the exact full success law, gamma uniqueness and complete time set for every k>=0, N>=2. Standard-library verifier checks all 27475 connected labeled graphs up to order six with exact fractions and 13 cone blocks; finite tests are supplementary only.

value.rationale: Gives a natural complete necessary-and-sufficient classification of deterministic finite-time search for the canonical reversible random-walk Laplacian on all connected simple graphs, including unique hopping coefficient and every perfect time. Unlike routine special-case calculation, the sharp degree-moment obstruction shows precisely when degree normalization destroys universal-vertex search (e.g. a cone over P3). It establishes that among connected regular graphs only complete graphs admit exact success with this protocol, a physically meaningful boundary not settled by the source’s complete-graph and numerical hypercube analysis.
